subject: Social Media
title: AI-Generated Content
description: A fast breakdown of AI-Generated Content for builders.

hook.text: An AI creates a travel blog with perfect photos of places that don't exist. Followers plan trips. To nowhere.

buildup.text: AI tools now generate text, images, video, and voice. A single person can simulate an entire media company.

discovery.text: Some AI-generated accounts gained large followings before anyone realized no human was behind them.

twist.text: When revealed, audiences felt betrayed. But they couldn't explain why—the content quality hadn't changed.

climax.text: Platforms debate AI disclosure rules. But detecting AI content grows harder as the technology improves.

punchline.text: If you can't tell it's AI, does it matter?

quiz.question: Why is AI-generated influencer content controversial?
options: Audiences feel betrayed when they discover no human is behind it
